name: cadence-player
description: Cadence - a local desktop music player with the Better Lyrics engine and Better Lyrics Shaders effects
author: Cadence contributors

scripts.test:ui: npm run build:web && npx vite-node tests/browser/build-library.ts && node tests/browser/run-app.mjs
scripts.test:providers: npm run build:web && npx vite-node tests/browser/build-library.ts && npx vite-node tests/browser/provider-identity.ts
scripts.test:cache: npm run build:web && npx vite-node tests/browser/lyrics-cache-manager.ts
scripts.test:cache:clear: npm run build:web && npx vite-node tests/browser/build-library.ts && npx vite-node tests/browser/cache-clear.ts
scripts.test:alac: npm run build:web && npx vite-node tests/browser/alac-startup.ts
scripts.test:now-playing: npm run build:web && npx vite-node tests/browser/now-playing-layout.ts
